title: Q4 FY25 consolidated Ind-AS results
text: Consolidated quarterly revenue was INR 40,925 crore for March 2025, 41,764 crore for December 2024 and 37,923 crore for March 2024. Quarterly profit before tax: 9,663, 9,670 and 10,240 crore respectively. Total profit for each period: 7,038, 6,822 and 7,975 crore. PAT here includes non-controlling interests. FY25 annual revenue: 162,990 crore; annual PBT: 37,608 crore; annual total profit: 26,750 crore.

title: Q4 FY25 earnings call
text: Management reported FY25 constant-currency revenue growth of 4.2%, operating margin of 21.1%, free cash flow of USD 4.1 billion and large deals of USD 11.6 billion. These are management-reported full-year measures, distinct from quarterly INR growth.

title: Q4 FY24 earnings call — original FY25 guidance
text: On April 18, 2024 management guided for FY25 revenue growth of 1% to 3% in constant currency and operating margin of 20% to 22%. This records initial guidance, not subsequent revisions.

title: Integrated Annual Report FY2024–25
text: The CEO letter describes Infosys work in AI, cloud, data and digital services. It reports FY25 operating margin of 21.1% and free cash flow of USD 4.1 billion.
